responsibility: Defines the HP-UX 11.11-specific `-munix=98` option for the PA port. It updates `flag_pa_unix` to request the UNIX 98 predefined and link environment, complementing the startup and CPP logic in the HP-UX 11.11 target headers.
same_name_distinction: HP-UX 11.11 option-table file: unlike pa-hpux1111.h, it only defines munix=98 by assigning flag_pa_unix=1998, while the header uses that setting to choose the corresponding startup environment.
